newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Third party to arbitrate in Swiss steel debacle.
newsitem.headline: Third party to arbitrate in Swiss steel debacle.

text.p: Swiss steel and technology groups Von Roll Holding AG and von Moos Holding AG said they had decided to resolve their differences by setting up a group of experts that would decide how much von Roll should pay to clean up the Gerlafingen steel plant.
A joint statement issued on Sunday by the two companies said this solution would ensure that the concept of a Swiss steel group should be finalised this year.
The group will be chaired by Giorgio Behr and its mandate is to review and quickly decide on all the disagreements between Von Roll and von Moos.
"The partners to the contract recognise the decisions of the group of experts," the statement said.
Under the deal, which was also agreed to by creditor banks, von Moos will continue to operate the Gerlafingen steel plant.
In June, the two companies agreed that von Moos would take over Von Roll's Swiss steel activities.
But last week von Moos said it would declare the deal invalid because a review had shown higher environmental protection costs and lower production capacity than had been represented in the contract.
Late on Friday, Von Roll confirmed that it would stand by the deal to sell its steel activities to von Moos.
